::: {.callout-note}
### Easily Editable in Quarto & R
All tutorials in this section are built directly with Quarto (`.qmd`) and R. You can clone the repository, run the code chunks in RStudio, or create new posts simply by adding a new subfolder in `posts/`!
:::
